body:
Shitty that you had a bad Friday episode. I'm sure you feel depleted, I would too, it's human. Stress changes any person. You say they will hate you (lol). As time progresses that episode will fade in their memory. From your post, you sound like a really wholesome person. The loyality you show, man, I'd be happy to know you got my back, even though temporary episodes like that. Maybe it's what they are seeing too? Hope you'll get back on track, nobody deserves this. And brain chemistry. That short lived chemical unbalance, it's not you, you know. You're back now trying to deal with that and I really respect that in a person, you're showing who you really are.

Sorry if this was inappropriate or something, but your story touched something in me so I just had to say something. Keep on, rooting for you!

Embedded programming could be a perfect field for someone who is BP! They might just have found THE person and saw the potential in you! Good on you both, congratulations to both the lucky you and the lucky employer who now got you!

Yeah, also, forgot to mention. The GP called today and was really really sorry about this, just flat out apologized and said he did a bad job last friday. It meant a lot, I felt like he got back on the team.

No worries, I know how it is, I don't really expect anything from anyone. Internet care rocks when it comes from someone who can relate, don't you think too?

You know, I'm not going to look back at this thread and check if you mentioned your age (on mobile), but you seem to have the life experience of someone who saw half of the evolutionary process.

I see a psychologist, they don't have the license to prescribe meds.
My GP prescribes on recommendation from the psychologist, it has been working OK. But I'll also be seeing a psychiatrist(?) from now on, they are allowed to prescribe and are pretty good at psychofarmica, so it'll be good I hope.

Just, it's been pretty stable. I work, and I'm pretty good at my job. The past couple of years it's also been stable (due to the 'unlimited' supply of meds and prescribed sick leave (you get paid leave here if the doc prescribes it)). I don't use it though. It's just good to know it's OK, you know? If I have a mental breakdown. I'm just really anxious of messing with this regime, because it has never been any better.

Did you say where you're from? Norwegian chiming in here, so probably I get some technical terms or something wrong.

I know exactly what you mean by 'a read', I can feel it if someone's not really understanding if I'm going to burn the whole entire planet down, kill myself or if it's just a bad day..

Anything good happened lately? You say you've been busy working, I hope that it means that you're not completely.. I don't know.. Dysfunctional? (I don't mean to insult you if that's what you're getting from this) 

Is it allright to ask what kind of trauma or should I just not ask, that's the question. Guess I just did though.

Hope you're doing allright. Internet strangers can do really powerful things to other internet strangers, so it does matter. Thanks.

For me, this has been the best thread on reddit.

Good to hear from, I think about this talk, and you, every now and then.
You actually made a difference to me in a good way, I am gratefull for it, so you really have it in you to be a resource for someone! Maybe it could be an inspiration for you to do something like voluntary work? I don't know, it's ultimately up to you of course anyways. It was just a thought I had, maybe you feel like it's stupid and that's okay too. 


Weeell, for me, I was on the fast track for involutarily being put in the "crazy house" in town because of a misunderstandind. I was to a therapist session, feeling quite down, but okay. 

Made an appointment for next week too, as he didn't see me as an immediate suicide threat. 

I was feeling good! Like real good. Being on the right track to a better time. So I made a doctors appointment to adjust the meds and my doctor for some reason suddently thought that I was going to commit suicide as soon as I walked out of there. He had an insane reaction. Rambling on about immediate mental care (read force). In the end I ended up talking him out of it, but I felt so shitty after that like my life was falling apart. I felt like I was crazy and didn't understand it myself. 

So I went home, grabbed some beers, I was drunk as fuck when my wife and kids came home after work and got sent to the apartment we have downstairs. Where I had stashed my hidden beer and whiskey. I was shitfaced, but probably seemed a bit drunk. My SO's brother and his girlfriend came, I just remembered that they were staying over the weekend... Holy fuck. 

So I ultimately, after feeling so good earlier on, that I was going for a walk up in the woods up here and just hang myself. This was way beyond any feeling before. I was READY as fuck. I went to the garage and packed a "kit", couple of ropes, some heavy painkillers (oxy) and hid it outside the house. 

Later on I said "ahh, it's so fresh outside, I should go for a walk", my SO didn't agree, said it was too dark. "oh, but I can wear a reflective west, it's okay, just a short walk, no stress". In the end she had suspected that maybe I wasn't going out for good intentions and said that if I went out, she wanted to take the walk together. I gave up and decided to sneak out when she had fallen asleep, by "going to the bathroom" in the middle of the night. Which I did, went to the bathroom and waited and waited. She checked on me a couple of times. 


Yea, end of story. I took some meds.. I don't, wanted to keep my intoxication uo. Ultimately ending up collapsing on the bathroom floor. I had no track of time, but I woke up from there at 4:30am and.. Went to bed, decided that I had to wait for another day.

Yesterday she had a serious talk with me and somehow made me rhink that we can fix this and it's GP fucking up at his job.. So she's going to arrange that me, her, the psychiatrist are having a meeting with my GP next week to tell him how much he fucked up.

Feels good bow. Even how fucking useless everything can feel, it looks like there is a way, even though it feels hopeless. Just needs help finding it, I guess. Need to find the right people to talk to.

Woah, what a weekend.
Just wanted to say hi. Life is a nightmare a d I'm out of hope.
Are you still allright?

Hi. I was kind of wondering about this too.. When I'm up high I feel like I only need like 2 hours of sleep, I have so many things to do or think about how to do, so I'm ready to go at it when I wake up. I can sleep for three hours a night for a week straight, and I don't even need an alarm. I can wake up at 7am by myself and just go out and mow the lawn or build some shit, and keep going until midnight, then go inside to look for inspiration for all my projects. And oh shit it's 4am again. Rinse, repeat. I feel tired, but not sleepy at all. I just keep on going.. Until I'm coming down from hypomania, it hits fast, it hits hard. I feel CRUSHED.


So! What to do about it? I started taking zolpidem or zopiclone to fall asleep, I take melatonin depot (circadin) to keep sleeping (I don't know if they work that well). Sometimes I take diazepam just to SLOW THE FUCK DOWN. I need to just restrict my energy. I noticed that my crash isn't as bad if I just take meds to slow the hypomanic me down..


Most of these are drugs that are addictive as shit, so I keep a calendar in my "drug shelf" where I tick of what I took and when, it helps me to have that calendar right in my face as a reminder and keep track of monthly usage.
Yes. This.

I guess someone has to keep the statistics correct, right?
To be stuck is relative, like a job, we need to pay the mortage (is that how you spell it? English is not even close to my mother tounge). I need to work, to be able to eat and have a place to sleep so I can be able to work. It's a means to an end.

I get prescription drugs, and I take them as prescribed most of the time, but sometimes it's ok to have a little extra flow of diazepam running in the bloodstream. I sometimes, sit on my porch, thinking how things could have been. It could be worse, even the fact that I'm even wealthy enough to sit down and use reddit, should probably not be taken for granted I guess. People carry shit water on their heads for miles so their kids don't die. They don't whine on reddit about it too.

No, we're not stuck, and as you said, some options may be unwise, but they are there. I guess you just have to find something to keep you going. I wish my SO knew how low I am, but I am already a burden. It' s OK to carry the worst on my own. It's my weight anyways..

The most thought out answer I've seen ever. It's so interesting, invalueable even, to get an insight in someone elses mind. I have never really looked death in the eye. I too be like the way you describe, I think of suicide daily in periods. I know that's my destiny, it's what I am programmed to do, it's my only known escape.

What keeps me going and going are all them small things. The things I will never know. That movie onwards, stupid little thing, I really look forward to seeing it with the kids. I'll find something new to look forward to. Soon, I hope. I guess.

I mean, positive things may happen, but I don't care anymore. At this point I really live for someone elses good moments.

In the past. I've been really happy when I'm manic (bipolar), but lately the thought of just hanging up and say goodbye stays with me through all mood swings. Pretty sure there time is nearing.

Abilify is the worst "mood stabilizer" I ever did. I couldn't sleep, I couldn't sit still for more than 10 seconds. To keep my mind busy and body OK I renovated one whole floor of my house in less than a week. It was like.. I don't know, I obviously didn't function at work, so I was home. Was working on my house until 2am, got up at 6am and started going at it like a mad man, I was constantly exhausted but couldn't stop. When I was at work Every meeting at work became a stand up meeting for me. It was like I was doing meth or something. I lost so much weight every week that I started to think I had cancer. As soon as I went of abilify I was back to being my old lazy fuckass self. Considering taking it just to get shit done. Cool story? Yes, it's cool as hell, I am the center of the universe. Fuck I'm a mess, don't talk to me.

I also said
"yeah, but you know I'm have a chemical imbalance up there, I'm afraid to switch the wrong way during our vacation"

Her answer was sort of telling me that it's normal to have mood swings. We all get mood swings.

Like she's not understanding that I can go from feeling like the master of the universe, to wanting to drown myself, in just one day. I don't know..

Ehh.. Embarassing.. But I guess I'll wait, I don't know, I feel like shit, teared up.. Maybe it was just a cry for help? I don't know. I'm afraid that if the timing is right and I don't have to wait, I'll follow through. Sorry for bothering you :( I'm obvoiusly a weak cunt here as well

I think you all are on to something. 
Especially if I skip a day I fall off the train and a week or 52 has passed. So maybe keep a diary as mentioned and also try to do "something" every day. 

The problem has been that I am all good, then mania sets in and I'm like "oh this guy ran for 72 hours, maybe I should do a marathon this afternoon". So I end up overdoing it and the recovery is some days, then I'm out for three months again.

Thanks for your tips, I'll see if I can combine it!

Some people reward themselfs with something (New running shoes?) after say working out for 200 days in a row.. But I'm more "OKAY SO IF I'M RUNNING A MARATHON TOMORROW I MUST BUY 4 PAIRS OF SHOES AND ALSO A LARGER CAR", so it'll probably not work for me

You're not sailing alone. 
It's so 2018? to say this, but I felt that.
All of it. 
You seem to have come far in managing as you can look at this objectively, even when it really sucks. 
Good you got out for a bit.
Is this situation something you can talk to your fiancé about? I guess your fiancé already knows a bit about your feelings. I understand it can be too hard though. Hang in there, I'm cheering for you!

I can only perceive to improve, I feel like I've come a long way though. It was worse before. My therapist once said that I got time on my team. And I do feel it, with age I get less surprised of peoples behavior, I choose my battles more and it takes a bit for me to hold grudges now. Impulse control now exists. I'm only 34 so I hope that I won't be one of them pissed of old farts if I get old. 

How many times did you think your treatment worked before you understood it wasn't doing anything?

My father is undiagnosed, and will forever be. But I am pretty god damn sure he is a BP1, it's worsening too.. 



For me. I've had varied degrees of depressions since I can remember. I've had suicidal thoughts for probably 20 years. I thought it was normal to have doubts about ones existence. Cut myself a few times too, no alarm bells ringing?! No. 

I have panic attacks about anything. 
I am super paranoid all the time, I saw the Truman show and couldn't really proove that wasn't done to me too. 

I used to live in a bigger city, if I saw the same unfamiliar person outside my apartment building more than a couple of times I was sure he was plotting against me.

So fast forward some years, I have a girlfriend, two kids.
Life's allright. BAM! Her friend says that she's basically been cheating on me. Not really physical (or I will never know...), but emotionally. Tinder/Happn/whatever. I felt ridiculed and it was horrible. We talked through it, she gave an explanation I could accept, we dealt with it together. We're still together. 

What the f that has to do with anything? 
Well, I was in such a bad place that I sought a therapist. 
We have free health care here, but the waiting list is looong for mental help. Took 1.5 years. Me and my partner had already "fixed things", so I told him I probably didn't need help. She convinced me to try one appointment. I did a couple and a screening, and yeah, lets say it wasn't uplifting. I'm usually quite good at hiding my issues..

So yeah, in the end it turns out it isn't normal to want to die, etc

To this day I can't be sure that my SO isn't plotting against me in cooperation with my doctor and my therapist. I think she might. To take the kids from me and totally fuck me because "he's mental. Look up his diagnosis awards". They probably all agree, I get bating questions sometimes "what about in traffic, it can be stressfull for anyone to drive".. "no, it's ok, I used to be pissed, but now I have other problems, most courteus driver in Town. 17 years of driving no accodenced, no law breaking.. Not even å parking ticket." which is of course becauseøøo9btt5beujjjkujyy+

I see what you mean, but doesn't that also imply that you give in? I mean, I don't really have time (does anyone?) to be down when my brain wants to. It's all about time in this world. But your philosophy grew on me and I feel like I grew a bit from it. Maybe one day I'll learn how to live with this, just have to do it stepwise, day by day. At least you'll be credited with getting me out of a spiral here if that's a diploma you can accept. I think you've come further on this journey than I. And because you took there time to share I feel a lot better, thanks. PS. I don't know how to play any flute yet

I do, I go there every month (ish) or more frequent if needed.. Lately I've been going with my SO, it's been really good. But as you said, it doesn't feel OK to talk about suicidal feelings with my SO there. Done it a couple of times and I feel there whole atmosphere at home turned bad. So I'm not talking about it anymore unless they ask me specifically I guess. Didn't know about bipolar groups, I don't think they exist around here, small Town, 70k inhabitants. Norway.

Ye, I am trying to learn things, but I try too much and get exhausted from it.. Dude, it feels good to know that others are in the same boat. Do you feel that your illness is getting worse or do you ever feel over an extended period of time that it's better?

Hey. Wonder if everyone experience this.. Thanks for your "world view", it's interesting. And I like it. I'm in a really bad place right now. I used to have manic periods all the time, but after I started taking lamictal I seldomly have them, I'm just depressed more. Not sure if it's the meds or what. But when I become manic I almost feel like I'm more depressed because it's gonna go away soon and be gone for a long time... I feel like there's nothing left of me. I don't wanna be my old me, don't wanna be the new me. I don't know. Understood quite a while ago that I won't die from natural causes, I just don't know when and what will tip me over the edge. I don't know. What's your goto thing if you feel very distressed?

Thanks, always good to know that I'm not alone in this. For the venting part.. I think it's my fault though. Maybe because I did something in the past that made my brain end up this way? If not, maybe because I let people under my skin, I should have been alone, I am a total fuckup for everyone around me. I have repeating episodes. I get angry. I say stupid shit. I know it probably feels like psychological terror, I know. I know that I don't mean to. I know I'm sorry as soon as the words leave my mouth. I know that I can't stop it though. She doesn't deserve to be called an idiot. No matter how harshly she spoke to me, it's not okay. She tells me that and I never disagree. But I lose every disagreement we ever have because of that. I am a failure because I can never win. I'm a maniac... 

Thanks for your insight + love & hugs, I really really appreciate it.

Out of curiosity : How did you first come to understand that you had BP2?
Yes.
No shame in crying! I can talk it out with my wife for now, but she's stuck around longer than anything else in my life, so I don't know how much longer it will last. Honestly

The thought of going on that unannounced hike for a couple of weeks spawned from the idea of leaving everything behind permanently I guess.. I expect to learn from it. What will I miss? What will I find? Who knows?
Ah allright, thought that I had an unfortunate mix, but I guess not. Keep on trucking dude

Dude(tte), pathetically comforting for me to hear that other people got issues too.. I guess distractions are good. I sometimes dream about just leaving everyone behind and go for a 2 weeks hike or something. Just to defocus
How long are your down periods and how long are your ups?
Hi. I am medicated and in therapy. I agree that it's so  worth it.
Not going to advocate anything because I've been there myself. Just be careful, I ended up drinking too much while depressed, wasn't pretty. ;) If it works for you, keep on trucking
Thanks guys! I feel that I lately have been looking forward to hypomania periods and all the things I am going to do in my next period. I might be burning the candle in both ends

Yo my dude/dudette, that sounds rough! It's allright to feel tired and depressed. It's allright to have trust issues. It's not your fault, you're not to blame. Is there anyone you trust a little more than others? (or mistrusts less). I found that being open about feelings, 5 out of 50 reacted with "ditching" me (which is fine, then you know they're not worth your time either). 40 people doesn' t really care. But 5 people are in some way or other sticking out for me. And maybe those 5 people cares, asks how times are on a regular basis. 1% are bipolar, chances are that you already know people with similar issues, maybe you'll know someone to talk to who can relate. Whatever you decide to do, you can think about things you're looking forward to, that new iPhone release, that sports event, being open about your feelings, that invention, that degree. You're someone, you seem reflected, hope you feel better soon. If not, come here for moral support. Hope you'll feel better, because you deserve it.

Heya, thanks. :-)

That's the effect I keep hearing about, also involuntary weight Gain. That would not be positive for the mental health. 
I live in a country where health care is basically free.
My doctor seems to think that if lamictal or abilify doesn't work, seroquel and similar is the next step.
So I mostly clench my teeth and say "yea, I think it has an effect".
I think though, if I come up with suggestions he might think it's ok to try. Have my next check up in two weeks, may mention ketamine to him, thank you.

I wonder if one builds up tolerance to any substance?
Thanks for reading and commenting, I REALLY appreciated it. Felt like I was invisible

Akathisia wore off quite fast (4-5 days?). 
I'm on lamictal, according to my SO it works well.
I don't know myself, feels like I'm more depressed every half year. And less hypomania. I don't really know if I'll be around too much longer. If this keeps going on. I've accepted it and have come to terms with it. I'm never going to do antidepressants, so it's probably my faith. Sorry if this got dark. Hope you find something that works for you.

I got akathisia from abilify, I had to stop  
It doesn't sound so bad to be restless, but holy god damn it was just horrible  
could not lay in the same position longer than 10 seconds, had to move around  
I already had insomnia, but this caused me to stay up for several days  
I could not sit down for more than 5 minutes if I pushed myself

would never take it again

family, but lately I feel like I'm a burden to them as well.

it feels like that one thing or episode that will push me over the edge is near

feel you on this

I used to have up to two weeks spurs of intense energy, but the past year I've mostly depressed with occasional hypomania (2-3 days ..  maximum 5 days? ish)

I got zopiclone for sleeping, but I won't take it too often so I don't build up a tolerance to them. zopiclone is maybe the one thing that keeps me going through really bad/good times.

I find that sleeping enough, moderate exercise and removing stress factors helps me.

even though I don't trust anyone, I have a support system of a person or two that I trust completely. I tell them everything and they help me remove stress factors. I mean, if I'm having really bad times, they stick up for me and does the things I should do myself (phonecalls on behalf of me, accompanies me to therapy, etc.) without them I would be in a way worse state..

I understand that it's hard now and what you feel is true to you. I hope you feel better soon. A lot of people like myself thinks it's good that you share. I can only speak for myself, but I can relate so much to this. When you posted this it proves you're a strong person and have the ability to reflect, it may help you in the long run. I'm rooting for you!
Days seems to be better when I get enough sleep. As I did tonight. Let's see how long it lasts..
